title: Simple Randomized Whitelist message
description: Allows server owners to manage their servers whitelist messages by turning them into randomized messages configurable by the server owner and can be turned on/off
body:
Very basic and simple randomized whitelist messages apon being rejected by server whitelist.  
- Native MC version: 1.21.8
- Tested server softwares: Spigot
- Commands: (permission: randomwhitelist.manage) /rwl <enable|disable|reload> 
- Permissions: randomwhitelist.manage (Command permissions)
> - Config file to edit messages under `plugins/RandomWhitelist/messages`
